title: Travel Supply and Partner Supplier Allowances — Home Oxygen Therapy Terms Sheet
content:
# Travel and Relocation Terms Sheet — Home Oxygen Therapy

The travel figures of Home Oxygen Therapy are kept per system class: the days of extra portable supply delivered for travel inside the Summit Ridge service area, the business days of notice needed before out-of-area travel to arrange a partner supplier, the longest out-of-area stay one partner arrangement covers, and whether Summit Ridge must arrange a successor supplier when the patient moves outside the service area during the furnishing obligation.

| System class | Extra portable supply for in-area travel (days) | Notice before out-of-area travel (business days) | Longest stay one partner arrangement covers (days) | Successor supplier arranged on a move outside the service area |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Stationary Concentrator Oxygen (E1390) | 7 | 10 | 30 | yes |
| Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431) | 14 | 10 | 30 | yes |
| Concentrator with Home Fill System (E1390 + K0738) | 14 | 10 | 30 | yes |
| Concentrator with Portable Oxygen Concentrator (E1390 + E1392) | 14 | 10 | 30 | yes |
| Liquid Oxygen System (E0439 + E0434) | 7 | 10 | 30 | yes |
| High-Flow Concentrator with Portable Cylinders (E1390 + E0431) | 14 | 10 | 30 | yes |

## Points of reading

- In-area travel supply is 7 days for Stationary Concentrator Oxygen (E1390) and Liquid Oxygen System (E0439 + E0434), and 14 days for the four other classes.
- The notice figure (10 business days) and the longest partner stay (30 days) are the same for every class.
